source.stem: The diagram shows a quadrilateral on a 1 cm² grid.

parts.text: Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral. [1]
Work out the area of this quadrilateral. Give the units of your answer. [3]

hinge.title: Decide how to use the parallel sides and height to find the area of a trapezium.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_08/ch_207. The student must decide: Decide how to use the parallel sides and height to find the area of a trapezium.
